title: Module 2 Boss Challenge: Assemble a High-Volume Support Agent
scenario: You are building a real-time e-commerce order tracker for Black Friday. It must handle 10,000 queries/minute, verify order IDs against PostgreSQL, and answer shipping ETAs with sub-second latency.

options.title: Ultra-Large 400B Flagship Model ($0.05/1k tokens, 3.5s latency)
options.reason: Too slow and expensive for high-volume, low-latency lookups.

options.title: Fast Lightweight 8B Model with Tool Calling ($0.0002/1k tokens, 120ms latency)
options.reason: Optimal balance of low latency, ultra-low cost, and sufficient tool execution capability.

slots.prompt: Choose the correct tools required for this agent:

options.title: Live SQL Database / Order API Wrapper
options.reason: Allows real-time query of order status without stale hardcoded text.

options.title: Hardcoded text document with static inventory tables
options.reason: Violates modularity and will serve stale data.

options.title: Notification / SMS Dispatcher Tool
options.reason: Allows the agent to send live status updates.

options.title: 'You are an order tracking assistant. Verify order IDs via Order API, provide concise ETAs, and escalate missing items to live support.'
options.reason: Clear role, bounded tool invocation guidance, and escalation path.

options.title: 'Answer whatever the user asks. If order is missing, guess the ETA.'
options.reason: Encourages hallucination and lacks tool boundaries.
